bio: Welcome to Harvard, Class of 2029! While I’m originally from Baltimore, Maryland, I’ve traded crab cakes and football for clam chowder and hockey and now consider myself a proud Cantabrigian. I graduated from Harvard in 2016 with a degree in anthropology. Immediately after graduating, I worked briefly in tech in Dallas where I met my husband and co-proctor Cole. I'm now a Senior Admissions Officer for the College and completed my master's at the Harvard Graduate School of Education this past spring. Outside of work, I love yoga, cuddling on the couch with our 15-year-old cat Ripley, and exploring the Boston arts and comedy scene. Cole and I can’t wait to meet you!
